raw_comment:
What do you notice?

I notice that there are droughts all across the country and that in almost every state there is some amount of a drought. Also I noticed that throughout most of the middle of the country, there are large amounts of severe droughts. The coasts have much less issues overall than the center of the country.
What do you wonder?

I wonder what could be causing the droughts besides just teh weather, like why are the coasts less affected. Also I wonder why Alaska has no issues despite being partly inner coastal.
How does this relate to you and your community?

This relates to me because I live in this country and It affects my life. Things need water to function and droughts make a big impact on this so it affects me and people around me.
Create a catchy headline that captures the graph’s main idea.

The dry midwest.
